start.title: Welcome 👋
start.content: Welcome to SortSensei! Let's get started.

create.title: 1. 🚀 Create Your Array
create.content: Create a custom array or generate a random one.

input.title: 2. ✍️ Enter Your Solution

validate.content: Use these buttons to validate your solution.
